name: Apple
description: A sweet, crisp fruit that comes in red, green, or yellow varieties and is rich in fiber and antioxidants.

name: Banana
description: A soft, elongated yellow fruit that provides instant energy and is high in potassium.

name: Orange
description: A juicy citrus fruit known for its tangy flavor and high vitamin C content.

name: Mango
description: A tropical fruit with sweet, golden flesh often called the 'king of fruits.'

name: Pineapple
description: A tropical fruit with spiky skin and juicy, tart-sweet yellow flesh.

name: Strawberry
description: A small red berry with a sweet flavor and tiny edible seeds on its surface.

name: Watermelon
description: A large, refreshing fruit with green rind and sweet, juicy red or pink interior.

name: Grapes
description: Small round fruits that grow in clusters and can be eaten fresh or made into wine.

name: Kiwi
description: A small brown fruit with fuzzy skin and bright green, tangy flesh inside.

name: Papaya
description: A tropical fruit with orange flesh, black seeds, and a mild, sweet flavor.

name: Peach
description: A soft, fuzzy fruit with juicy yellow or white flesh and a sweet aroma.

name: Cherry
description: A small, round, red or black fruit with a sweet or tart flavor and a single seed inside.

name: Blueberry
description: A small, round blue fruit packed with antioxidants and often used in desserts.

name: Pomegranate
description: A round fruit with thick skin and many juicy red seeds rich in antioxidants.

name: Lemon
description: A bright yellow citrus fruit known for its sour taste and refreshing aroma.
